population.tape_source: Literal arrivals and physical catalogues from the original source protocol; no regeneration, filtering or seed selection.

new_controls.delay: Existing complete-catalogue batch SJF heuristic: select smallest mean completion offset across every admitted job, including the loaded resident; tie by larger current queue support, shorter reserved duration and option index. FIFO admission and full physical reservation. It is not a mean-flow oracle.
new_controls.no_background: Existing ContinuousArrivalAgeTailLaneRollout: retain FIFO tagged jobs, eight shared prefix samples through tau_max, MW complete-drain continuation, aggregate sampled S2 no worse than MW, minimum S1 with strict improvement, original ties and queue envelope. Remove sampled post-tau_max untagged background competitors and their combined-event overflow and computation.

execution.unit_order: 0..95 delay, 96..191 no_background, each in original protocol tape order
execution.causal_context: Current queue, lane availability, FIFO ages and causally released cumulative births divided by now. Real future arrivals, true rates and evaluation stop time stay in the harness.
execution.clock: Original cached independent-lane physical service clock with one-second idle polling; computation is measured separately and adds no service delay.
execution.placement: 192 independent CPU1 tasks on available node001-node006; BLAS1, no trajectory or whole-directory download.
execution.source_identity: Freeze literal original dependencies plus the new runner, block statistics and paired-outcome helpers at registration. Save each new full trajectory on the server before outcome checks and small row output.

outcomes.orientation: New control minus cached BG; negative means the new control is better.
primary: Equal-tape restricted mean flow at1200 for all births in closed cohort[300,900]
Equal-tape P90 at1200 on each comparison's common completed job IDs
secondary: All twenty-four catalogue/load/class results and class tails
outcomes.common_population: Recompute common completed job IDs separately for BG versus each control and MW versus each control at each cutoff. Do not reuse the original BG/MW common-ID P90 population.
outcomes.work: Count every actual controller constructor, root/continuation option scan, preprocessing, prefix sampling, rate and age reads, flow evaluations and overflow work. Record actual selector/worker time separately from algorithm performance.

statistics.definition: Paired whole-seed-block percentile 95% intervals for each control separately at900 and1200. Mean/P90 use aggregate mean differences and ratios; unfinished uses absolute total differences. Pointwise exploratory intervals, no multiplicity adjustment.

interpretation: A post-confirmation extension on already observed arrival tapes, conditional on fixed planning streams, not independent confirmation. Methods and budgets are fixed before these control outcomes are computed. Preserve all negative group/class/seed effects. Do not change the original BG confirmation PASS, automatically adopt a control, tune coefficients or revive the retired finite branch. If batch SJF dominates BG, the claim of BG superiority must narrow; if removing background is as good, the claimed mechanism needs revision. Paper edits wait until the evidence is settled.
